Definition: a cardinal number, eight (as if a surplus above the 'perfect' seven); also (as ordinal) eighth
BiblicalUsage: 1) eight, eighth; 1a) eight (as cardinal number); 1b) eighth (as ordinal number); 1c) in combination with other numbers
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
